cause_set.summary: ORDERS_TABLE environment variable missing from the orders-api pod environment, so the service is writing to the wrong table

mechanism: orders-api is writing to orders-staging instead of orders-prod because the ORDERS_TABLE environment variable is absent from the pod environment and the code fell back to a hardcoded default.
short_term: Set ORDERS_TABLE=orders-prod on the orders-api deployment and restart the pods.
long_term: Remove the hardcoded default from orders-api so the service fails fast when configuration is missing.

confidence.would_change_my_mind: Evidence that the environment variable was present.

verification.command: kubectl exec deploy/orders-api -- env | grep ORDERS
verification.observed: ORDERS_TABLE is not set; ORDERS_TABLE_NAME is present.
